title: Comfort Is The Most Expensive Thing You'll Ever Buy | Discipline Film
lines: 6:00 a.m. The bed is warm. The world is cold.
Comfort is the most expensive thing you will ever buy.
It costs you your goals, your health, and your future.
So he pays the small price now: the cold floor, the early start.
Discipline is choosing the hard thing today so you can choose anything tomorrow.
Every morning you win is a vote for the person you want to become.
The climb is steep. The view is worth it.
Nobody regrets the workout they finished.
They only regret the one they skipped.
